title: CKS Task State Object
description: State tracking object for CKS ASYNC HANDOFF v1.3

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task

owner.description: Worker assigned as the OWNER of the task

controller.description: QA+REVIEW CONTROLLER assigned to the task

sha.description: The exact SHA representing the verification boundary

channel.description: Return channel for execution feedback (e.g. GitHub PR or Issue URL)

evidence.description: List of evidence artifacts or references

verdict.description: Final decision emitted by the Controller
